Third-party files used by the Care Plan Builder paper downloads, loaded by the browser only on download.

- `docx.js`: npm `docx` 9.16.0, `dist/index.iife.js` (license: docx.LICENSE)
- `jspdf.js`: npm `jspdf` 4.2.1, `dist/jspdf.umd.min.js` (license: jspdf.LICENSE)
- `fonts/Tinos-*.ttf`: npm `@expo-google-fonts/tinos` 0.4.2, metric-compatible with Times New Roman (license: fonts/LICENSE)
